name: tell-tail
description: Inspect local desktop logs and trace Codex tool results on Apple Silicon Macs.

interface.longDescription: See which Codex tools ran, how long they took, and which reported failures. Tell-Tail runs on Apple Silicon Macs. After installing, ask to open your Codex logs for a live local dashboard of supported desktop events and MCP connections. For ongoing tool-call tracing, run setup once and restart Codex. Setup configures a local exporter and a service that starts at login. Ask Tell-Tail to uninstall the collector before removing the plugin. Activity and tool results retain diagnostic metadata in memory. Application logs you add can show excerpts of the original errors.
